onboarding.phases.label: Setup steps
onboarding.agents.title: Choose your AI providers.
onboarding.agents.lede: Install the ones you want to use. Next you'll connect their accounts to your workspace.
onboarding.agent.system_broken: what this machine has belongs to another app · downloads {size}
onboarding.workspace.lede: A space for your projects, accounts and context sources.
onboarding.workspace.name: Workspace name
onboarding.workspace.hint: For example: your company, a client or a personal project.
onboarding.workspace.notice: Providers are installed once on this computer. The accounts you connect next will belong only to this workspace.
onboarding.workspace.footer: You can create more spaces later.
onboarding.accounts.title: Connect your accounts.
onboarding.accounts.lede: Choose which accounts your agents will use in {workspace}.
onboarding.accounts.none: You didn't choose any providers. You can install them later in Settings.
onboarding.accounts.footer: You can connect the remaining accounts later.
onboarding.sources.title: Connect your repositories.
onboarding.sources.lede: This step is optional. It lets you search the repositories your account can access.
onboarding.sources.github_how: Authorize in the browser and choose the access
onboarding.sources.footer: Repository credentials are separate from AI accounts.
onboarding.context.title: Choose your main context source.
onboarding.context.read_only: This source is read-only: your agents consult it, but never edit it.
onboarding.context.lede: The reference information that gives direction to your agents' work.
onboarding.context.url_hint: HTTPS or SSH. For a private repository, connect GitHub or Bitbucket first.
onboarding.context.notice: This is the workspace's main context source. The folder where you'll produce your work is chosen in the next step.
onboarding.context.footer: You can update or change the context later.
onboarding.workdir.title: Add your first project.
onboarding.workdir.lede: This is where you'll create and edit files with your agents.
onboarding.workdir.name: Project name
onboarding.workdir.url_hint: HTTPS or SSH. It's cloned with this computer's git and credentials.
onboarding.workdir.summary_new: A new folder will be created inside {path}.
onboarding.workdir.summary_existing: This folder will be used as it is; its files are kept.
onboarding.workdir.summary_clone: The repository will be cloned into a new folder inside {path}.
onboarding.workdir.footer: The context source and this folder serve different purposes.
